name: plugin.ontology_spider
description: Formal logic reasoning, multi-hop dependency traversal, and schema validation over Brain Harness vaults
author: Brain Harness Epistemics Engine

entrypoints.name: load_vault_ontology
entrypoints.description: Load a vault-shaped knowledge graph export or directory into an Ontology-Spider model

parameters.name: vault_source
parameters.description: Path to vault JSON file, directory, or raw JSON string

entrypoints.name: query_ontology
entrypoints.description: Execute a logic reasoning query (ancestors, transitive, recommend, pattern) with proof explanations

parameters.name: vault_source
parameters.description: Path to vault JSON file or directory

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Controlled Dialog query (e.g. 'query transitive depends_on from impl_plugin')

entrypoints.name: validate_ontology
entrypoints.description: Validate schema constraints, acyclicity, domain/range, and disjointness across vault ontology

parameters.name: vault_source
parameters.description: Path to vault JSON file or directory
